description: Brings back an earlier version of a report by saving its content as a NEW newest version. Nothing is deleted or overwritten: every version saved before stays in the history, and the restore itself shows there as a new version saved by the assistant. Send the version to bring back and the newest version number you read (list_report_versions gives both); if someone saved a newer version since, nothing is saved and the answer is stale with the newest number, so read the history again first. Only someone who may save a new version of the report may restore one. The answer gives the new version's number, not its content. Bringing back what the newest version already holds saves nothing: the answer says unchanged, with the newest version's number. If a public link still shows an older version because the new one failed the share check, warning and linkLag say which link and which part held it: tell the person, take that part out, and save again.

expected_version.description: The report's newest version number when you read it.

version.description: The number of the version whose content to bring back.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: restore_report_version
title: Bring back an earlier version of a report
